subject: Add traceability and data-cutoff fields to tool return
description: SRQ2 names traceability as a required property; it has zero implementation. Add: absolute target period (not the relative string 'next month'), data_window/cutoff, model version or run id, and a call id for tool-call logging. Mirror the example return in rationale note section 6.
activeForm: Adding traceability fields to the tool contract
